usage: telegram-tools settings set [-h] --chat CHAT --slow-mode SECONDS

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --chat CHAT          The chat: numeric ID, @username, or link
  --slow-mode SECONDS  Seconds between one member's messages: 0 (off), 10, 30,
                       60, 300, 900 or 3600
